scope: Original Saturn resource and SH-2 static analysis plus independent asset decoding. No game, emulator, or engine execution.

format.header: BE16 width, BE16 height; no PC DWORD-2 prefix
format.rle: Start at +4; per row while x<width: byte>127 skips byte-128 positions, otherwise copies byte literal indices. Next row advances 512 bytes in the original destination. Stop after height rows.
format.transparent: Skipped positions leave destination unchanged. All 94 decoded slots have zero literal occurrences of index 0. Opacity exports are derived from literal versus skip commands, not from palette high bit.
format.tail: 32 slots have exactly one nonzero byte immediately after the final consumed RLE command; all later bytes are zero. The original height-bounded decoder does not read that byte. Do not treat it as palette data.
format.decoder_evidence: PROG 0x2897E/0x28990 dimensions; 0x289E2 offset=4; 0x28A5A threshold127; 0x28A6E subtract128 via signed-byte+128; 0x28B10 destination; 0x28B58 stride512.

palette.scope: One fixed 256-colour palette for the portrait/dialogue bitmap layer, independent of the scene bitmap palette; not a separate palette embedded in each portrait.
palette.format: Big-endian 16-bit CCBBBBBGGGGGRRRRR. RGB8 output is RGB5<<3, not bit-replication to 255; bit15 is colour-calculation control, not alpha.
palette.load_chain: PROG 0xF136..0xF146 loads ALLDAT.NEW; 0xF148..0xF158 copies its first0x1000 bytes to 0x25F00000.
palette.bank_chain: 003C/003D table at0x56EB4/0x56EB8 calls0x9E94/0x9F48; both call0x10DA4 with r7=3. At0x10DF0..0x10DFC, low8(r7) goes to0x2574(1,3). 0x25EE selects r4=0 then0x3D7E0 writes low3 bits of byte060FFCEC. The shadow base060FFCC0 is copied to25F80000 by0x402D6..0x40300, so this is BMPNA high byte: NBG1 palette number3.
palette.bitmap_binding: 0x63EA..0x63F4 configures NBG1 bitmap at25E20000, 8bpp; normal game setup0x6CD4..0x6CD8 sets destination pointer06076C84=25E20000. Decoder uses that pointer.
palette.mode_and_offset: Initial RAMCTL mode1 set at0x63CC..0x63D0 through0x3DD08 (RGB555,2048 entries). Default register block0x3F620 has CRAOFA/CRAOFB=0; no direct nonzero write found in reviewed normal initialisation/portrait selection path.

manuals.supports: BMPNA NBG1 bits10..8 and 256-colour palette-index composition.
Mode1 RGB555, R0..4/G5..9/B10..14, zero-filled lower3 output bits; bit15 is not alpha.

placement.algorithm: x-left = center_x - floor(width/2); y-top = center_y - floor(height/2), destination stride512 with wrap modulo0x20000. Raw byte copies, no scaling in portrait decoder.
placement.coordinate_boundary: These are CPU bitmap coordinates. Initial NBG1 Y scroll is -12 (16.16 fixed point) via0x6418..0x6420/0x3DD7C. Final viewport/window/composite coordinates and hardware transitions were not measured.

id_mapping.policy_supported_by_sources: Direct identity replacement is supported for the86 nonzero Win portrait IDs with paired raw-script anchors; retain PC resource for38 and any slot lacking an audited mapping.

id_mapping.raw_identity_chain: Dispatcher0x767E..0x7688 puts operand0 at060A1A6A; top/bottom handlers read it unchanged into r6. 0x10E30..0x10E48 requests sector=portraitID*5,size=0x2800 fromRGM.JOE. Aligned dialogue anchors independently show the same requested ID on PC and Saturn.
